# QA Plan: Sprint 5

**Date**: 2026-07-10
**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 7 stories (S5-03 through S5-09), 0 systems with new code this sprint
**Engine**: Godot 4.6.2 (`.claude/docs/technical-preferences.md`)
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-05.md`

---

## Important Scoping Note

Sprint 5 is a **design sprint**: its Must-Have and most Should-Have work is GDD
authoring and process tasks (epic/story creation, cross-GDD review), not code. The
standard 5-type QA taxonomy (Logic / Integration / Visual-Feel / UI / Config-Data)
assumes code stories with GDD Formulas and Acceptance Criteria sections to derive
test cases from. None of S5-03 through S5-06 produce code, so there is nothing to
unit-test or integration-test this sprint. Their quality gate is `/design-review`
and `/review-all-gdds`, not automated tests — do not force-fit a testing framework
onto documents.

S5-08 (the one potential code story) does not have a story file yet — it will be
created by S5-06 mid-sprint, at which point this plan should be extended (re-run
`/qa-plan story:[path]` once that file exists) rather than guessed at now.

## Manual QA Checklist

### S5-03 — Author Inventory System GDD
**Verification method**: `/design-review design/gdd/inventory.md`
**Who must sign off**: game-designer (author) + creative-director (via `/review-all-gdds`, S5-05)
**Evidence to capture**: `/design-review` verdict recorded in the GDD's own status header

Checklist:
- [ ] All 8 required GDD sections present (Overview, Player Fantasy, Detailed Rules, Formulas, Edge Cases, Dependencies, Tuning Knobs, Acceptance Criteria)
- [ ] Formulas include variable definitions, expected ranges, and example calculations (per `.claude/rules/design-docs.md`)
- [ ] Edge cases state concrete behavior, not "handle gracefully"
- [ ] Dependencies are bidirectional — any GDD Inventory depends on (EventBus, Save & Persistence) is checked for a reciprocal mention
- [ ] `/design-review` verdict is not MAJOR REVISION NEEDED

### S5-04 — Author Resource Economy System GDD
**Verification method**: `/design-review design/gdd/resource-economy.md`
**Who must sign off**: game-designer (author) + creative-director (via `/review-all-gdds`, S5-05)
**Evidence to capture**: `/design-review` verdict recorded in the GDD's own status header

Checklist:
- [ ] All 8 required GDD sections present
- [ ] Formulas (material drop rates, gold flow, sink/faucet balance) include variable definitions and worked examples
- [ ] Explicitly reconciled against Inventory's item/material model (sequencing risk flagged in the sprint plan)
- [ ] `/design-review` verdict is not MAJOR REVISION NEEDED

### S5-05 — `/review-all-gdds` re-run
**Verification method**: `/review-all-gdds`
**Who must sign off**: creative-director
**Evidence to capture**: cross-GDD review report file in `design/gdd/` (e.g. `gdd-cross-review-[date].md`)

Checklist:
- [ ] Report verdict is not FAIL
- [ ] Any new consistency issues between Inventory/Resource Economy and the 9 existing GDDs are resolved or explicitly accepted
- [ ] No stale references introduced in either new GDD or any existing GDD they touch

### S5-06 — Create Epic 03 + first story batch
**Verification method**: Manual review of the generated epic and story files
**Who must sign off**: producer
**Evidence to capture**: `production/epics/epic-03-core-economy/EPIC.md` (or equivalent) + story files

Checklist:
- [ ] Epic file replaces the current one-line placeholder in `production/epics/index.md`
- [ ] At least 2-3 stories are implementation-ready (embed GDD requirement ID + governing ADR reference, per this project's story convention)
- [ ] Story dependencies correctly reflect the GDD's own Dependencies section

### S5-07 — Fix stale epic status docs
**Verification method**: Direct comparison against actual shipped state
**Who must sign off**: technical-director
**Evidence to capture**: diff of the two corrected files

Checklist:
- [ ] `production/epics/index.md`'s Epic 04 row shows "Complete" (matching its own `EPIC.md`)
- [ ] `epic-01-foundation.md`'s GameDataRegistry/SceneManager rows no longer say "not yet implemented" (both are fully built — confirmed via this session's extensive test evidence)

### S5-09 — TD-monster-004 real-profiler capture (opportunistic)
**Verification method**: Live Godot profiler session, 150 active monsters, 60 consecutive physics frames
**Who must sign off**: technical-director
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/monster-perf-[date].png` and `monster-aoe-perf-[date].png`, per the GDD's literal path requirement

Checklist:
- [ ] Monster System `_physics_process` CPU time ≤ 2.0ms/frame with 150 active monsters (AC-28)
- [ ] AoE variant (AC-40) measured per its own GDD text
- [ ] Evidence files saved to the exact paths `design/gdd/monster.md` specifies

*Only attempt if live Godot MCP/editor tooling is reachable this sprint — do not
block sprint completion on this item (Nice to Have, opportunistic per the sprint plan).*

## Smoke Test Scope

Sprint 5 makes no code changes to `src/` (S5-08 stretch goal excepted). The smoke
test baseline remains whatever the last code-bearing sprint (Sprint 4) established:

1. Game launches to "The Gap" mission scene without crash (confirmed working as of
   `TD-project-001`'s fix this session — re-verify this hasn't regressed if S5-08
   touches any code)
2. Full SCOUT → WAVE_ACTIVE → INTERMISSION → MISSION_COMPLETE/DEFEAT phase loop
3. Save/load cycle completes without data loss
4. If S5-08 is attempted: whatever new Inventory code paths it introduces

*If S5-08 is not attempted, `/smoke-check sprint` is optional this sprint — there
is no new code to regress-check. Run it anyway if S5-07's doc fixes are the only
change, purely as a baseline confirmation, or skip if capacity is tight.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] S5-03/S5-04: `/design-review` verdict recorded, not MAJOR REVISION NEEDED
- [ ] S5-05: `/review-all-gdds` verdict recorded, not FAIL
- [ ] S5-06: Epic 03 file + at least 2-3 implementation-ready stories exist
- [ ] S5-07: both stale-doc corrections verified against actual shipped state
- [ ] S5-08 (if attempted): test file exists per this project's standard convention; `/story-done` checks for it
- [ ] S5-09 (if attempted): profiler evidence files exist at the exact paths specified
- [ ] No regressions introduced to the existing 650/650 test suite
